svg.title: ROSETTA STONE 6-LAYER DATA CLEANING & CANONICAL FIELD MAPPING REFERENCE
svg.desc: Detailed engineering reference diagram illustrating the 6 canonical data-cleaning transformations applied to Fantasy402, GSLive Partner 118, and Polymarket feeds: (1) TicketNumber-WagerNumber composite parent grouping, (2) BLOCKED drop & ALERT mirror zeroing, (3) FreePlayFlag='Y' zero-principal loss & Stake/Payout/Liability separation, (4) Teaser effective line & DGS GameNum+5000 parent rotation normalization, (5) IP-Tracker Mode B Per-Office vs Global & Mode C YYYY-MM-DD date rewrite, and (6) 4-Surface Identity Join with 11-char space-padded PaddedCustomerId write enforcement.

svg.text: ROSETTA STONE 6-LAYER DATA CLEANING & CANONICAL FIELD MAPPING REFERENCE

De-obfuscated report.js • help-report.js • bet-ticker.js • ip-tracker.js -> Canonical TypeScript Primitives • ID: SD-ARTIFACT-02-6LAYER-CLEANING • Live R2 Portal: https://pub-d061f943df0e4477ba7ff200721eddb1.r2.dev/graph.html
LAYER 1: PARENT TICKET DEDUPLICATION
Upstream Source: report.js / help-report.js (api/Report/Pending)
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (1 Row Per Leg Repeats Full Ticket Risk):
Row 1: Ticket 901104-1 (Leg 1 LAL 1Q) -> AmountWagered: 1620000
Row 2: Ticket 901104-1 (Leg 2 LAL -3) -> AmountWagered: 1620000
✅ CLEANED RULE (evaluateMode9PendingExposure):
Group by composite key: d.TicketNumber + "-" + d.WagerNumber
• Counts Stake ($16,200) & ToWin ($42,120) strictly 1x per parent ticket
• Prevents 2x–6x exposure inflation on multi-leg parlays & teasers
Used by: Mode 9 (Pending Exposure) & Mode 7 (Combo Hash)
LAYER 2: CHANNEL & TWIN DEDUPLICATION
Upstream Source: bet-ticker.js (POST /cloud/api/Manager/getBetTicker)
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (Sentinel & Syndicate Mirror Duplication):
TicketWriter="BLOCKED" noise rows + "ALERT" mirror twin slips
emitted within <=6s of primary Internet / GSLIVE / GSBUILDER bet
✅ CLEANED RULE (L19.N0518 & L21.N0884):
Drop BLOCKED pre-grouping; set ALERT canonicalVolumeCents = 0
• Preserves ALERT row for sub-250ms syndicate velocity telemetry
• Eliminates 100% of twin double-counting in Mode 9 liability
Used by: Mode 9 (Pending Exposure) & Tab 5 ROT Bet-Ticker
LAYER 3: EFFECTIVE LINE & DGS ROT+5000 MATH
Upstream Source: report.js getLineGame() & getRotationNumber()
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (Split Teaser Fields & Child Rotation IDs):
Teasers split across AdjSpread/AdjTotalPoints + TeaserPoints;
DGS Alt-Spreads book on GameNum + 5000 (ROT 5501 vs 501)
✅ CLEANED RULE (computeEffectiveLineHundredths):
Spread: Adj+Teaser | Over: Adj-Teaser | Under: Adj+Teaser
• Stores exact integer LineHundredths (-7.5 -> -750, 48.5 -> 4850)
• Normalizes ROT 5501 -> Parent ROT 501 for Polymarket matching
Used by: Mode 7 (Wager Comparison) & Probit Corr Guard
LAYER 4: FREE-PLAY & SIGN NORMALIZATION
Upstream Source: help-report.js (FreePlayFlag & getTransactions)
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (Free-Play Asymmetric Cash Accounting):
FreePlayFlag="Y" Loss (WagerStatus="L") debits $0 cash principal;
FreePlay Win credits only ToWinAmount (stake is never returned)
✅ CLEANED RULE (Modes 8, 9 & 10):
FreePlay Stake = $0 | Payout = Stake+ToWin | Liability = ToWin
• Tracks freePlayLostPrincipalSavedCents ($3,000 on MJ102)
• Enforces CUSTOMER_PERSPECTIVE_POSITIVE_IS_PLAYER_WIN
Used by: Mode 8 (Settled Net), Mode 9, Mode 10 (Reconciliation)
LAYER 5: IP-TRACKER MODE & OVERLAP HYGIENE
Upstream Source: ip-tracker.js lines 76–89 (Manager/getWebLog)
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (Overloaded customerID & Date Inversion):
Mode B uses customerID=<OfficeAgentID> for Per-Office match vs "0"
for Global; Mode C requires YYYY-MM-DD while A/B/I require MM/DD/YYYY
✅ CLEANED RULE (formatWebLogDateForMode & Mode 6):
Auto-formats dates per mode & separates Session vs Point Overlap
• Distinguishes 270s Concurrent Session Overlap (MJ102 <-> MJ103)
• From 24s Nearby Point Events without session overlap (CHURN_059)
Used by: Modes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (Identity & Network)
LAYER 6: 4-SURFACE ID & 11-CHAR WRITE GUARD
Upstream Source: Manager/updateByColumn & GSLive Partner 118
❌ RAW FEED QUIRK (Silent Write No-Ops & Scope Rejection):
Unpadded customerID returns Result: 0 (SILENT_NO_OP); passing
master BILLY666 returns Result: -1; passing path causes HTTP 500
✅ CLEANED RULE (padCustomerIdCanonical & Scope Guard):
"MJ102" -> "MJ102 " (11 chars) + direct office agentID="MJ2026"
• Unifies F402 LoginID + Office AgentLogin + GSLive player_[login] + 0x
• Verifies every write via POST /cloud/api/Manager/getInfoPlayer
Used by: Mode 1 Drill-Downs & Ban-Hammer Mutation Engine

⚡ OPERATOR CLI & LIVE LINKS: ./bin/dx modes 7 | ./bin/dx modes 9 | ./bin/dx modes 10 | node --test tests/forensic_diagnostic_modes.test.ts → https://pub-d061f943df0e4477ba7ff200721eddb1.r2.dev/graph.html
